translation: neTsela, iElef, neYevusi — le yinguYerushalayimi — iGibha, iKiryat: iindidi ezilishumi eline kunye neezapeлa zazo; le yindlela esizalwe ngayo iinkosi ezilishumi eline; oku kungokwabadala abaneenkokeli; le yingcwele yamadoda alishumi elinane; oku kwakumkhozi kwezi ndidi; le yindlela ebizwa ngayo iinkosi ezine; le yingcwele yamadoda amane; oku kwakufumanwa kwindawo yamadoda amane; le yindlela esebenziswa ngayo iinkosi ezilishumi eline; le yingcwele; oku kungokwabantwana baseYehuda kummandla wabo wonke; oku kwakungokwabantu abahlala eYerushalayimi; le yindlela; oku kubalulekile kakhulu; le yingcwele yamadoda alishumi elinambini; oku kubizwa ngokuba yindlela; le yingcwele; oku kuneenkokeli ezine; le yindlela entsha; oku kungokwamadoda amakhulu; le yingcwele; oku kuthathwa njengento engcwele; le yindlela eqhelekileyo; oku kubalulekile; le yingcwele yamadoda alishumi elinesibini; oku kubonakala kakhulu; le yindlela; oku kungokwabantu abathile; le yingcwele; oku kuneempawu ezine; le yindlela; oku kubizwa ngegama elithile; le yingcwele; oku kungokwamadoda amaninzi; oku kubalulekile kakhulu; le yindlela engaqhelekanga; oku kungamkelwa yabhenu; oku kuphela kwesi sishwankathelo.
